metadata.name: GetHoldTransactionDetail
metadata.description: Use this API to retrieve the hold transactions and related hold placed on different wallets/saving pockets as applicable.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account Number of the cardholder. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 2000000000000396893 Condition:At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition :At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition :At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number/Account Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Unique number assigned to a transaction and is used to track the transaction posted in CoreCard System Valid values : 0-9 Example :  147852369 Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: TransactionDescription
children.description: Description of transaction Valid Values:A-Z,a-z Example: Load

children.name: LogicModule
children.description: Logic Module of Transaction. Valid values : 0-99 Example: 95

children.name: CurrencyCodeAlphabetic
children.description: Transaction amount Currency Name Valid values : a-z Example:USD

children.name: CurrencyCodeNumeric
children.description: Transaction amount Currency code Valid values : 0-9 Example: 026

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Transaction Amount Valid Values: 0-9 Example:100.11

children.name: TotalHoldAmount
children.description: Total amount to be hold Valid values : 0-9 Example:500.30

children.name: TotalHoldAmountCurrencyCodeAlphabetic
children.description: Currency Name in which transaction is performed. Valid values : a-z Example:USD

children.name: TotalHoldAmountCurrencyCodeNumeric
children.description: Currency code in which transaction is performed. Valid values: 0-9 Example: 026

children.name: Description
children.description: Description of sweeping. Examples:Qualifying Wallet

children.name: SourceWalletID
children.description: TWallet ID of wallet from which funds should be transferred\debited Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: SourceWalletName
children.description: Wallet /Saving Pocket Name of Source Wallet. Examples : Retirement Saving

children.name: SourceWalletCurrencyCodeAlphabetic
children.description: Currency Name of Source Wallet Valid values : a-z Example:USD

children.name: SourceWalletCurrencyCodeNumeric
children.description: Currency Code of Source Wallet Valid values : 0-9 Example:026

children.name: SourceAmount
children.description: Source Amount Valid values : 0-9 Example:600.30

children.name: DestinationWalletID
children.description: Wallet ID of wallet in which funds should be transferred\credited Valid values:0-9 Example:1005

children.name: DestinationWalletName
children.description: Wallet /Saving Pocket Name of Destination Wallet. Valid values : a-z,0-9 Examples:Child education

children.name: DestinationWalletCurrencyCodeAlphabetic
children.description: Currency Name of Destination Wallet. Valid values : a-z Example:USD

children.name: DestinationWalletCurrencyCodeNumeric
children.description: Currency Code of Destination Wallet. Valid values : 0-9 Example: 026

children.name: DestinationAmount
children.description: Destination Amount Valid values : 0-9 Example:600.30

children.name: PostingWallet
children.description: Wallet is posting wallet or not. Valid Values:Yes ,Null Example:Yes

children.name: TotalAmount
children.description: Total Sweeped Amount. Valid value : 0-9 Example:600.30

children.name: TotalAmountCurrencyCodeAlphabetic
children.description: Currency Name in which sweeping is performed. Valid values : a-z Example:USD

children.name: TotalAmountCurrencyCodeNumeric
children.description: Currency Code in which sweeping is performed. Valid value : 0-9 Example:026
